ma.setCapsuleShow(Object object)

Sets whether to hide the capsule(Minimum version: 25.3.0)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
isShow Boolean true No Indicates whether to display the capsule. The options are as follows: false: no; true: yes.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String setCapsuleShow: ok

object.fail Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String setCapsuleShow: fail, + error cause (null if no result is returned)

Sample Code

ma.setCapsuleShow({
  isShow: false,
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  complete(res) {
    console.log(res);
  }
});
